name: same_open_brush
desc: Clean up the pixel art to match a polished game sprite: crisp continuous dark outline, smooth clean shading bands with no noisy or stray pixels, bright glossy highlights like wet paint. Keep the exact pose, design, size and left-facing side view. Inside the gaping mouth make it a filthy gooey paint gullet: the tongue is a drooping blob of thick pink paint, globs of yellow and pink paint pooling and sliding down the throat, only a few short sticky strands between the jaws.
